sections.voiceover: On November 13, 2026, New Regency sued Michael Mann in California federal court. Filings show the studio wants 3 copyright termination notices declared invalid. Will court 2:26-cv-13316 resolve ownership before January 19?
b_roll: Court filing document header with date November 13 2026
Document page highlighting 3 termination notices text
Calendar graphics zooming on January 19 date

sections.voiceover: However, the director attempted to reclaim ownership of the original Heat screenplay.

Mann's representatives stated the lawsuit isn't related to Heat 2 filming on January 19. Production remains scheduled to begin filming on January 19. Court records confirm Case 13316 leaves ownership rights disputed in California.
b_roll: Movie production slate with date January 19
Central District of California court seal

sections.voiceover: Filming starts January 19 while federal courts evaluate case 13316.
